Ruhpolding (German pronunciation: [ˈʁuːpɔldɪŋ]) is the

Ruhpolding

municipality with the biggest area of the Traunstein district in

Municipality

southeastern Bavaria, Germany. It is situated in the south of

the Chiemgau region in the Alps and next to the Austrian

border.

The economy is based on tourism and sports. Major winter

sports held in the district include biathlon and Ski jumping.

Other sports which are possible for tourists and residents

are golf, mountainbiking, shooting, hiking, fly fishing and

skiing.

Cup event has taken place, in the 1992–93 season. In

Ruhpolding.
